text:
deploy-bot: Release v2.3.1 deployment started · staged by region (US -> EU -> APAC). Change window 12:00-13:30 UTC. Canary: us-canary-17. Notes: https://redwood/release/2.3.1 :rocket:

alex: starting US canary now, will watch p50/p95 and token error rate. tagging infra for capacity watch.

priya: pre-checks for APAC: apac-gpu-pool nodes=8, used=6, spare=2, avg queued requests=3. baseline token latency ~12ms.

ryan: US canary stable at p95=210ms, error rate 0.02%. pushing EU canary in ~10m.

priya: quick heads-up — running a synthetic burst to validate autoscaler for APAC once EU looks good.

deploy-bot: EU canary promoted at 12:18 UTC. Routing update: traffic split us:5%->100% canary, eu:5%->100% canary.

ryan: EU looks fine so far. triggering APAC canary smoke — please monitor apac-gpu-pool and queue length.

priya: running smoke now. sending metrics in channel in 2m.

priya: (metrics) apac-gpu-pool cpu=92%, mem=81%, pending-requests=18, avg-queue-time=72s. autoscaler did +1 node but queue stayed high.

alex: hmm that's higher than expected. any logs on reason for queue?

ryan: seeing KV cache miss spike for apac requests; model variant heavier tokenization for some workloads. means more GPU work per request.

sasha: based on that, I recommend we avoid full APAC rollout until we either add capacity or pin APAC to v2.3.0 model variant (lighter quant/profile).

ming: alternative: route APAC to dedicated pool ded-apac-1 (has 6 spare GPUs) — more cost but immediate relief.

alex: what's the fastest safe action?

sasha: fastest is to pin APAC routing to previous model variant. command:
```
redwood routes pin --region=apac --model=redwood-model-v2.3.0 --until="2026-03-21T18:00:00Z"
```
Or we can rollback the release in APAC:
```
/deploy rollback v2.3.1 --region=apac
```
Either will keep US/EU on v2.3.1.

priya: infra can spin up 2 more nodes in ded-apac-1 but ETA ~22m to be fully ready.

alex: decision: pin APAC to v2.3.0 now, continue rollout for US/EU. infra to add nodes in parallel. we'll re-run APAC canary after capacity verified.

ryan: acknowledged. applying pin.

deploy-bot: routing update applied: apac pinned to redwood-model-v2.3.0 until 2026-03-21T18:00:00Z.

alex: thanks. please watch error budgets and queue length. if queue > 10 for 5m, flip to ded-apac-1 and notify #incidents.

ming: infra starting node add now (2 nodes). monitoring dashboard: https://monitoring/redwood/apac-pool

sasha: post-deploy action items: (1) triage KV cache miss pattern for APAC workload, (2) consider quantization tweak for next build, (3) cost analysis for routing to dedicated pool.

priya: noted, I'll own #1 and #2. will update thread with ETA for canary re-run. :white_check_mark: 

alex: great. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
